fee_notes: Fee varies by territory type: Six-Mile Primary Service Area = $30,000; Single Point Location = $25,000; Airport Locations range from $30,000 to $125,000 depending on enplanement/deplanement figures and car rental revenue statistics (e.g., $125,000 for Los Angeles and Orlando; $75,000 for Atlanta, Denver, Miami, Phoenix, San Francisco, Tampa; down to $30,000 for numerous smaller airports). A military veteran discount of the greater of 10% or $2,500 off the standard fee is available (with repayment required if franchise is transferred before two-year anniversary to a non-veteran). The Initial Franchise Fee includes an ASAP Computer System setup fee of $3,750. The fee is non-refundable and fully earned upon signing. Franchisor may negotiate fees on a case-by-case basis. During the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, no Priceless franchises were sold.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") for new franchisees is payable in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement and varies, depending upon the type of territory you select: Six-Mile Primary Service Area -- $30,000; Single Point Location -- $25,000; Airport Location -- The Initial Franchise Fees for Airport Locations vary depending upon airport enplanement/deplanement figures and car rental revenue statistics, and as of the date of this disclosure document are as follows: $125,000: Los Angeles, CA; Orlando, FL ... All other secondary airport locations: $30,000
